title: Boundary mass of the slice of a boundary current by a Lipschitz function
statement: Assume, as a hypothesis of the statement, (SL) (verbatim the antecedent (SL) of the selected statement): for P, k ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), measures μ, μ′ on ℝ^P finite on compact subsets of U, ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_{k+1} μ-a.e. strongly measurable and ξ′ : ℝ^P → Λ_k μ′-a.e. strongly measurable with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all α for μ-a.e. x and |ξ′(x)(β)| ≤ |β| for all β for μ′-a.e. x, T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(U), ∂T(η) = ∫ ξ′(x)(η(x)) dμ′(x) for every η ∈ 𝒟^k(U), and f : ℝ^P → ℝ L-Lipschitz (L ∈ ℝ≥0), there are A : ℝ → 𝒟_{k+1}(U) and B : ℝ → 𝒟_k(U) with (SL1) A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t} ξ(ω) dμ, (SL2) B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t} ξ′(η) dμ′, (SL3) ∂A_t(η) = B_t(η) whenever tsupport η is disjoint from {f = t}, (SL4) M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L·liminf_{h→0+} ofReal(h⁻¹)·μ(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}) for every open W (liminf along the filter 𝓝[>] 0, values in [0, ∞]) and (SL5) ∫⁻_{(a,b)} M_W(∂A_t − B_t) dt ≤ L·μ(W ∩ {a < f < b}) for every open W. Let P, m ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U), μ a measure on ℝ^P with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_m μ-a.e. strongly measurable such that for μ-a.e. x, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for every m-covector α, and assume ∂T(η) = ∫ ξ(x)(η(x)) dμ(x) for every η ∈ 𝒟^m(U). Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be L-Lipschitz (L ∈ ℝ≥0), t ∈ ℝ, W ⊆ ℝ^P open, and B ∈ 𝒟_m(U) with B(η) = ∫_{f<t} ξ(x)(η(x)) dμ(x) for every η ∈ 𝒟^m(U). Then boundaryMassOn B W ≤ L·liminf_{h→0+} ofReal(h⁻¹)·μ(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}) in [0, ∞] (liminf along 𝓝[>] 0; {t − h < f < t} = {x : t − h < f(x) ∧ f(x) < t}). Conventions (as in the frozen contract and SimonGMT Chapter06): ℝ^P = Euclid P (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)). For U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^k(U) = TestFormOn U k (smooth k-forms on ℝ^P whose compact tsupport lies in U) and 𝒟_k(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U k; X(ω) is the value of X on ω; X − Y is the contract subtraction, (X − Y)(ω) = X(ω) − Y(ω) (definitional); 0 is the zero current; ∂X = X.boundary with ∂X(η) = X(dη) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply); currents with equal values are equal (GeometricCurrentOn.ext). Λ_k = MultiVector P k (continuous linear functionals on k-covectors) and |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α (Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector). M_G(X) = X.massOn G ∈ [0, ∞] is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal X(ω) over the ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x (massAdmissibleOn U k G); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X); boundaryMassOn X G = M_G(∂X) if k ≥ 1 and 0 if k = 0. spt X = X.support = U \ X.zeroRegion, where X.zeroRegion is the union of the open W with compact closure contained in U on which X vanishes (X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω ⊆ W). Integrals ∫_E g dμ are Bochner integrals over μ⌞E; {d < t} abbreviates {x : d(x) < t}.
